title: OmniVseved
body:
OmniVseved is a recipe browser for Minecraft that feels like vanilla Creative tabs, but works like a full recipe viewer.

Vanilla-like Creative-style item browser with tabs

Reads recipes from vanilla + installed mods

Shows both:
Recipes (how to craft an item)
Usages (where an item is used)

Supports multiple recipe types (not only crafting table)

Fast search by item name or ID

Category sorting based on actual game tab data
